note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI shot Lootas Gamma for 1.2 expected damage and a 14% kill chance. It skipped Lootas Beta, which is already at about 10.3 expected damage against 10 HP, so the extra shots there could have finished it. Fix: Score marginal kill probability instead of expected damage minus allocated damage. Add shooters to a target until its kill chance is about 85% or higher, and avoid splitting fire onto a second target that cannot be killed. Give a bonus for targets that contest a held objective.
